summary: OpenAI announced that ChatGPT Voice is now available in the desktop app for macOS and Windows, powered by GPT-Live, letting users control their computer and direct multiple agents in ChatGPT Work or Codex by voice.

practices.reason: The post states GPT-Live lets the system speak, listen and coordinate multi-agent work simultaneously, a stated capability change though without benchmark evidence.
practices.quote: It’s powered by GPT-Live, so it can speak, listen, and coordinate work in the app at the same time.
